messages.author: 9f4efcdd48836db5
messages.subject: Re: Error while installing Rhipe
parts:
did you install the 'rJara' package?

do

>install.packages('rJava')

and 

>library(Rhipe)
>rhinit()

i think it work

messages.author: e2c98b724eefda3c
messages.subject: Re: Error while installing Rhipe
parts:
I have similar error, and I cannot install rJava. It gives me error:
Make sure you have Java Development Kit installed and correctly registered in R.
If in doubt, re-run "R CMD javareconf" as root.

My environment variable LD_LIBRARY_PATH is empty. But I can't seem to understand __PREFIX__/lib64/R/lib path to add. Any suggestions?

On Sunday, March 30, 2014 7:30:40 PM UTC-4, Kyung Hwan Lee wrote:
did you install the 'rJara' package?

do

>install.packages('rJava')

and 

>library(Rhipe)
>rhinit()

i think it work
